title: Beyond Human Norms: Unveiling Unique Values of Large Language Models through Interdisciplinary Approaches
reasoning: The paper focuses on constructing and evaluating the value systems of LLMs, identifying 'Integrity' and 'Character' as core dimensions. It explicitly incorporates ethical norms (fairness, transparency) and religious/faith-based values (Faith, Religion) as descriptors in its framework, comparing these against human ethical frameworks like Moral Foundations Theory (MFT) and Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values (STBHV).
